title: Implement raw-record to Exercise conversion
acceptance_criteria: Conversion produces valid Exercise objects without mutating parser output.
Every source type maps to Strength or Stretch, while the original source category remains available in the Exercise category field or an explicitly documented equivalent.
Stable ids are deterministic, unique for the 20 source records, and safe for existing filtering, routine, and storage code.
Purpose, description, equipment, setup, range, breathing, dose, sensation, regression, progression, evidence, and sources are preserved.
Muscles, specific muscles, steps, common errors, tags, sources, and compatibility instructions are populated as structured arrays; favorite and duration defaults are explicit.
completion_summary: Implemented pure Exercise catalogue conversion with typed validation errors, mapped categories, stable slug IDs, collision hashes, and compatibility defaults. Build/tests were blocked by shell permissions.
